# Sparkform effect catalogue

Every effect ships as one scene in `addons/sparkform/effects/`. Spawn it through the `Sparkform` autoload (`Sparkform.hit_spark(...)`) and pass a dictionary of property overrides as the last argument; the generated scene is pooled, so repeated spawns do not allocate.

The tables below are generated from the `##` comments in each effect script, so they match the inspector exactly. Shared properties that every effect inherits are listed once under [shared properties](#shared-properties).

## Index

| Effect | Spawner | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`acid_splash`](#acid-splash) | `acid_splash` | one-shot | Sticky acid: bubbles rise out of a splat and pop on a delay, each pop throwing a few droplets, while the puddle drips. |
| [`blink`](#blink) | `blink` | one-shot | Two-point teleport: the source collapses inward, a stretched streak snaps across the gap, then a ring and spark burst open at the destination. |
| [`chain_lightning`](#chain-lightning) | `chain` | one-shot | A bolt that hops between several points: each hop is its own jagged segment, revealed one after another, dimmer than the last. |
| [`cooldown_ring`](#cooldown-ring) | `cooldown_ring` | one-shot | Radial cooldown indicator drawn as an arc around a node. |
| [`debris_burst`](#debris-burst) | `debris_burst` | one-shot | Solid chunks instead of sparks: drawn shards with their own shape, spin and weight, so a broken crate or defeated enemy throws pieces rather than dust. |

| [`heal_sparkle`](#heal-sparkle) | `heal_sparkle` | one-shot | Ascending sparkles for pickups, heals, buffs and level-ups: motes drift up and outward, twinkle, and fade into a soft glow. |
| [`hit_spark`](#hit-spark) | `hit_spark` | one-shot | Impact spark: a bright flash plus a short directional burst of sparks. |
| [`impact_crack`](#impact-crack) | `impact_crack` | one-shot | Ground-aligned slam: jagged cracks race outward along the surface, dust puffs up between them and a flat flash marks the hit. |
| [`implosion`](#implosion) | `implosion` | one-shot | The reverse of an explosion: streaks spiral inward, accelerate, and vanish into a bright pinch. |
| [`lightning`](#lightning) | `lightning` | one-shot | Procedural lightning bolt with optional branches and flicker. |
| [`muzzle_flash`](#muzzle-flash) | `muzzle_flash` | one-shot | Directional gun/muzzle flash: torn cone of light, uneven star and a spray of sparks. |

| [`slash_arc`](#slash-arc) | `slash_arc` | one-shot | Melee crescent: a tapered arc that sweeps through its angle, shedding sparkles along the cut. |

| [`vortex`](#vortex) | `vortex` | persistent | A pull field: motes spawn on the rim, spiral inward and are recycled at the centre, inside a faint set of spinning arcs. |

## Shared properties

Declared on `VFXEffect`, inherited by every effect scene:

**Lifetime**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | `float` | `0.5` | How long the effect runs, in seconds. |
| `free_on_finish` | `bool` | `true` | Free the node as soon as the effect finishes. Pooled effects spawned through `Sparkform` always set this to `false`. |
| `play_on_ready` | `bool` | `false` | Play the effect as soon as it enters the tree (handy for effects dropped straight into a scene by hand). |

## One-shot effects

### acid_splash

<a id="acid-splash"></a>

`AcidSplashEffect`

Spawn with `Sparkform.acid_splash(at: Vector2, options: Dictionary = {}) -> AcidSplashEffect`.

Sticky acid: bubbles rise out of a splat and pop on a delay, each pop throwing
a few droplets, while the puddle drips. Non-additive on purpose: acid is a
substance, not light.

Spawn it with `Sparkform.acid_splash(at, {"bubble_count": 14})`.

**Splat**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `splat_radius` | `float` | `26.0` | Radius of the puddle left at the spawn point. |
| `splat_squash` | `float` | `0.4` | Vertical squash of the splat; 0 is a flat disc. |
| `splat_spread` | `float` | `210.0` | Splat width in pixels at full squash. |
| `drip_length` | `float` | `9.0` | How far the puddle drips below the splat. |

**Bubbles**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bubble_count` | `int` | `12` | Bubbles that rise out of the puddle. |
| `bubble_size` | `float` | `5.0` | Bubble radius in pixels. |
| `rise_speed` | `float` | `90.0` | Bubble climb speed in px/s. |
| `pop_delay` | `float` | `0.45` | Seconds before a bubble pops, randomised around this value. |
| `pop_droplets` | `int` | `3` | Droplets thrown by each pop. |
| `acid_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.52, 0.86, 0.24)` | Puddle and bubble tint. |
| `acid_dark` | `Color` | `Color(0.24, 0.48, 0.1)` | Darker tone for the puddle rim. |
| `droplet_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.72, 0.95, 0.4)` | Tint of the droplets thrown by pops. |

**Chaos**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.55` | Bubble sizes, pop timing and droplet scatter. |

**Methods**

- `get_bubble_count() -> int` — Bubble count; exposed for tests.
- `get_pop_count() -> int` — How many bubbles have popped so far; exposed for tests.

### blink

<a id="blink"></a>

`BlinkEffect`

Spawn with `Sparkform.blink(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, options: Dictionary = {}) -> BlinkEffect`.

Two-point teleport: the source collapses inward, a stretched streak snaps
across the gap, then a ring and spark burst open at the destination.

Spawn it with `Sparkform.blink(from, to)`.

**Jump**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `destination` | `Vector2` | `Vector2(220.0, 0.0)` | Destination in this node's local space. The spawner sets it from the two world points it is given. |
| `warp` | `float` | `0.22` | Fraction of the lifetime spent collapsing at the source before the jump. |
| `streak_width` | `float` | `9.0` | Width of the streak that snaps between the two points. |
| `spark_count` | `int` | `8` | Points of the spark ring that opens at the destination. |
| `warp_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.55, 0.85, 1.0)` | Tint of the collapsing warp at the source. |
| `core_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)` | Hot centre of the streak and of the destination burst. |

**Chaos**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.5` | Streak drift, ring timing and spark scatter. |

**Methods**

- `get_destination() -> Vector2` — Destination in local space; exposed for tests.

### chain_lightning

<a id="chain-lightning"></a>

`ChainLightningEffect`

Spawn with `Sparkform.chain(from: Vector2, targets: Array, options: Dictionary = {}) -> ChainLightningEffect`.

A bolt that hops between several points: each hop is its own jagged segment,
revealed one after another, dimmer than the last. Use it for chained hits,
fork attacks and multi-target shocks.

Spawn it with `Sparkform.chain(from, [enemy_a.global_position, ...])`.

**Chain**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `points` | `PackedVector2Array` | `PackedVector2Array([Vector2.ZERO, Vector2(160.0, -40.0)])` | Hops in this node's local space. The first entry is where the chain starts; `Sparkform.chain()` builds this from the spawn point and the targets. |
| `segments` | `int` | `13` | Jagged segments per hop; more is finer. |
| `hop_delay` | `float` | `0.06` | Seconds between one hop appearing and the next. |
| `falloff` | `float` | `0.78` | Brightness of each hop relative to the one before it. |
| `jaggedness` | `float` | `14.0` | Sideways wobble of the bolt, in pixels. |
| `flicker` | `float` | `0.05` | How often the bolt re-jags itself, in seconds (`0` freezes it). |
| `width` | `float` | `3.0` | Bolt line width in pixels. |
| `bolt_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.62, 0.78, 1.0)` | Outer bolt tint. |
| `core_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)` | Hot core tint. |

**Chaos**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.5` | Per-hop jaggedness, hop timing and flash scatter. |

**Methods**

- `get_hop_count() -> int` — Number of hops in the chain; exposed for tests.
- `get_first_hop() -> PackedVector2Array` — Points of the first hop; exposed for tests.

### cooldown_ring

<a id="cooldown-ring"></a>

`CooldownRing`

Spawn with `Sparkform.cooldown_ring(target: Node2D, seconds: float = 1.0, options: Dictionary = {}) -> CooldownRing`.

Radial cooldown indicator drawn as an arc around a node.

Unlike the other effects this node is a modifier, not a one-shot: add it as a
child of whatever it should circle (an ability icon, a turret, a unit) and
call `start`. It works in two directions:

```gdscript
# fills up over 2.5 seconds (charge bar)
var ring := Sparkform.cooldown_ring(icon, 2.5)

# drains from full (classic cooldown)
Sparkform.cooldown_ring(icon, 2.5, {"reverse": true})
```

The ring previews in the editor: tweak `progress` to see the arc.

**Shape**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | `float` | `42.0` | Ring radius in pixels. |
| `width` | `float` | `8.0` | Arc thickness in pixels. |
| `start_angle` | `float` | `-1.5708` | Where the arc starts, in radians. The default starts at 12 o'clock. |
| `clockwise` | `bool` | `true` | Draw the filled arc clockwise instead of counter-clockwise. |
| `tick_count` | `int` | `0` | Tick marks around the ring; 0 draws none. |
| `tick_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.35)` | Tick mark tint. |

**Colors**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fill_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.42, 0.9, 1.0)` | Colour of the filling arc. |
| `track_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.06, 0.09, 0.14, 0.6)` | Colour of the unfilled track. |
| `show_track` | `bool` | `true` | Draw the full track behind the fill. |

**Timing**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | `float` | `1.0` | Seconds for a full sweep. |
| `reverse` | `bool` | `false` | Start at full and drain to empty instead of filling up. |
| `free_on_complete` | `bool` | `true` | Free the node once the cooldown completes. Disable it if you want to reuse the same ring for several cooldowns. |

**Chaos**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.25` | Hand-drawn irregularity: the arc and ticks wobble slightly and a soft glow pulses. Kept low by default because a cooldown must stay readable. |
| `glow` | `bool` | `true` | Draw a soft glow under the arc. |

**Methods**

- `start(seconds: float = -1.0) -> void` — Starts the cooldown. `seconds` overrides `duration` when it is greater than zero.
- `cancel() -> void` — Stops the cooldown without emitting `completed` and clears the arc.
- `is_running() -> bool` — Returns `true` while the cooldown is running.
- `get_remaining() -> float` — Seconds left before the cooldown completes.

`DebrisBurstEffect`

Spawn with `Sparkform.debris_burst(at: Vector2, options: Dictionary = {}) -> VFXEffect`.

Solid chunks instead of sparks: drawn shards with their own shape, spin and
weight, so a broken crate or defeated enemy throws pieces rather than dust.

| `gravity` | `float` | `900.0` | Downward pull in px/s^2. |
| `drag` | `float` | `1.2` | Air resistance; higher stops chunks sooner. |
| `spin_speed` | `float` | `7.0` | Shard spin in rad/s. |
| `chunk_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.78, 0.74, 0.66)` | Lit face of the chunks. |

| `upward_bias` | `float` | `1.2` | Upward bias of the burst, in radians around straight up. |

| Property | Type | Default | Description |

| Property | Type | Default | Description |

| Property | Type | Default | Description |

### frost_burst

`FrostBurstEffect`

Spawn with `Sparkform.frost_burst(at: Vector2, options: Dictionary = {}) -> FrostBurstEffect`.

Angular ice: hard-edged shards thrown outward, a cold flash, then a slow
crystalline shimmer as they fall. Deliberately sharp next to the round

Spawn it with `Sparkform.frost_burst(at, {"shard_count": 20})`.

| `spin_speed` | `float` | `5.5` | Shard spin in rad/s. |
| `shimmer` | `float` | `0.6` | Amount of crystalline shimmer after the burst. |

| Property | Type | Default | Description |

### impact_crack

<a id="impact-crack"></a>

`ImpactCrackEffect`

Spawn with `Sparkform.impact_crack(at: Vector2, options: Dictionary = {}) -> ImpactCrackEffect`.

Ground-aligned slam: jagged cracks race outward along the surface, dust puffs

Spawn it with `Sparkform.impact_crack(at, {"radius": 140.0})`.

| `crack_width` | `float` | `3.5` | Crack line width. |
| `wander` | `float` | `0.45` | How much the crack path wanders as it runs out. |
| `surface` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.RIGHT` | Surface direction: the cracks spread around this axis (up is a ceiling hit). |

**Dust**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dust_count` | `int` | `8` | Dust puffs thrown up by the impact. |
| `dust_rise` | `float` | `70.0` | How far the dust climbs, in pixels. |
| `dust_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.42, 0.4, 0.38)` | Dust tint. |
| `crack_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.15, 0.13, 0.12)` | Crack tint. |
| `flash_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 0.86, 0.55)` | Tint of the flat flash. |

**Chaos**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.5` | Crack paths, branch kinks, dust scatter. |

**Methods**

- `get_crack_count() -> int` — Number of crack lines; exposed for tests.
- `get_first_crack() -> PackedVector2Array` — Points of the first crack; exposed for tests.

### implosion

<a id="implosion"></a>

`ImplosionEffect`

Spawn with `Sparkform.implosion(at: Vector2, options: Dictionary = {}) -> VFXEffect`.

The reverse of an explosion: streaks spiral inward, accelerate, and vanish into
a bright pinch. Use it for charge-ups, absorbs, vacuum pulls and dark magic.

Spawn it with `Sparkform.implosion(at, {"radius": 130.0})`.

**Collapse**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | `float` | `110.0` | Radius the streaks start on, in pixels. |
| `mote_count` | `int` | `26` | Motes pulled into the pinch. |
| `spiral` | `float` | `1.15` | Full turns each streak makes on its way in. |
| `converge` | `float` | `1.8` | How sharply the streaks accelerate as they close in. |
| `streak_length` | `float` | `8.0` | Length of each mote trail. |
| `mote_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.72, 0.55, 1.0)` | Mote tint. |
| `core_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 0.95, 1.0)` | Colour of the bright pinch. |

**Pinch**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pinch_size` | `float` | `0.14` | Radius of the flash at the end of the collapse, relative to `radius`. |

**Chaos**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.55` | Streak spacing, length and timing variance. |

**Methods**

### lightning

<a id="lightning"></a>

`LightningEffect`

Spawn with `Sparkform.lightning(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, options: Dictionary = {}) -> VFXEffect`.

Procedural lightning bolt with optional branches and flicker.

The bolt is regenerated a few times per second while it is alive, which reads
as electrical flicker. Spawn it with
`Sparkform.lightning(from, to, {"branches": 3})`.

**General**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `end_offset` | `Vector2` | `Vector2(220.0, 0.0)` | Endpoint of the bolt, in this node's local space. The convenience method sets it from the `to` argument minus `from`. |
| `bolt_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.55, 0.75, 1.0)` | Outer bolt tint. |
| `core_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)` | Hot core tint. |
| `segments` | `int` | `14` | Displacement steps; more is more jagged. |
| `jaggedness` | `float` | `0.45` | How far the bolt strays from the straight line between its endpoints. |
| `width` | `float` | `3.5` | Bolt line width in pixels. |
| `branches` | `int` | `2` | Forked side bolts per strike. |
| `flicker` | `float` | `0.6` | `0` freezes the bolt in shape, `1` reshapes it at the fastest flicker rate. |
| `flicker_interval` | `float` | `0.05` | Seconds between bolt regenerations. |

**Chaos**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.65` | How wild the bolt is: `0` keeps the configured branch count and a stable silhouette, `1` adds and drops branches per flicker, grows sub-branches and throws stray arcs. |

**Methods**

- `get_bolt_points() -> PackedVector2Array` — Current bolt polyline, in local space. Exposed for tests and tooling.
- `get_branch_points() -> Array[PackedVector2Array]` — Current branch polylines, in local space.
- `get_sputter_points() -> Array[PackedVector2Array]` — Current stray arcs, in local space. Only present with `chaos` above 0.

## Persistent modifiers

### beam

<a id="beam"></a>

`BeamEffect`

Spawn with `Sparkform.beam(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, options: Dictionary = {}) -> BeamEffect`.

Persistent beam: core line, glow, travelling pulses and flaring ends. For
sustained fire, grapple lines, tractor beams and charge links.

```gdscript
var beam := Sparkform.beam(from, to, {"width": 8.0})
beam.end_at(other.global_position)   # follow a target each frame
beam.stop()                          # fades out, then frees itself
```

**General**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `end_offset` | `Vector2` | `Vector2(320.0, 0.0)` | Endpoint relative to this node's position. Set by `Sparkform.beam()`. |

**Beam**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `width` | `float` | `6.0` | Core line width in pixels. |
| `glow_width` | `float` | `20.0` | Soft glow width around the core. |
| `pulse_speed` | `float` | `900.0` | Travel speed of the pulses in px/s. |
| `pulse_spacing` | `float` | `120.0` | Distance between pulses in pixels. |
| `wobble` | `float` | `0.35` | Side-to-side jitter of the core line. |

**Timing**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `warmup` | `float` | `0.12` | Seconds to open from nothing to full width. |
| `fade_time` | `float` | `0.22` | Seconds to fade out after stop(). |
| `lifetime` | `float` | `0.0` | Close on its own after this many seconds; `0` holds until stopped. |

**Colors**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `core_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 0.98, 0.9)` | Colour of the core line. |
| `glow_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.55, 0.8, 1.0)` | Colour of the surrounding glow. |
| `pulse_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)` | Colour of the travelling pulses. |

**Chaos**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.45` | Jitter along the beam and pulse spacing variance. |
| `free_on_finish` | `bool` | `true` | Free the node once it has faded out. |

**Methods**

- `end_at(endpoint: Vector2) -> void` — Points the beam at a new endpoint (local space).
- `start() -> void` — Starts the beam. Called by `Sparkform.beam()`.
- `stop() -> void` — Fades the beam out and frees it when `free_on_finish` is set.
- `get_openness() -> float` — Current opening amount, `0.0` to `1.0`.

### portal

<a id="portal"></a>

`PortalEffect`

Spawn with `Sparkform.portal(at: Vector2, options: Dictionary = {}) -> PortalEffect`.

Persistent gateway: an oval portal that opens, swirls while it is held, and
closes when you stop it. Spawn pads, teleports, summoning.

```gdscript
var gate := Sparkform.portal(at, {"width": 70.0, "height": 96.0})
gate.stop()   # plays the closing animation, then frees itself
```

**Shape**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `width` | `float` | `58.0` | Portal width in pixels. |
| `height` | `float` | `78.0` | Portal height in pixels. |
| `rim_width` | `float` | `4.0` | Thickness of the rim in pixels. |
| `spin_speed` | `float` | `1.8` | Rim rotation in rad/s. |
| `shimmer_count` | `int` | `14` | Shimmer motes inside the portal. |

**Timing**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open_time` | `float` | `0.3` | Seconds to open. |
| `close_time` | `float` | `0.35` | Seconds to close after stop(). |
| `lifetime` | `float` | `0.0` | Close on its own after this many seconds; `0` holds until stopped. |

**Colors**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rim_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.62, 0.55, 1.0)` | Rim tint. |
| `core_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.18, 0.12, 0.42)` | Interior tint. |
| `shimmer_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.85, 0.8, 1.0)` | Shimmer mote tint. |

**Chaos**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.45` | Rim waver and shimmer scatter. |
| `free_on_finish` | `bool` | `true` | Free the node once it has closed. |

**Methods**

- `start() -> void` — Opens the portal. Called by `Sparkform.portal()`.
- `stop() -> void` — Plays the closing animation; the node frees itself when `free_on_finish` is set.
- `get_openness() -> float` — Returns the opening amount, `0.0` closed to `1.0` open.

### rune_circle

<a id="rune-circle"></a>

`RuneCircle`

Spawn with `Sparkform.rune_circle(target: Node2D, seconds: float = 0.0, options: Dictionary = {}) -> RuneCircle`.

Persistent cast circle: a rotating ring of ticks and glyphs under a caster,
with an optional progressive fill that doubles as a cast bar.

Unlike the one-shot effects this node stays until you stop it:

```gdscript
var rune := Sparkform.rune_circle(caster, 1.5, {"fill": 0.0})
rune.set_fill(cast_progress)   # drive it yourself
rune.stop()
```

**General**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lifetime` | `float` | `0.0` | Seconds until it closes on its own; `0` means it runs until stopped. |
| `radius` | `float` | `54.0` | Circle radius in pixels. |
| `segments` | `int` | `12` | Rune ticks around the ring. |
| `spin_speed` | `float` | `0.7` | Rotation in rad/s. |
| `fill` | `float` | `0.0` | Progressive fill from 12 o'clock, `0.0` to `1.0`. |
| `rune_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.72, 0.62, 1.0)` | Glyph and tick tint. |
| `fill_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.92, 0.86, 1.0)` | Colour of the progressive fill. |
| `tick_length` | `float` | `9.0` | Length of each tick in pixels. |
| `pulse` | `float` | `0.35` | Brightness pulsing as it spins. |
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.25` | Wobble in the ring geometry. |
| `free_on_finish` | `bool` | `true` | Free the node when it stops. |

**Methods**

- `start(seconds: float = -1.0) -> void` — Starts (or restarts) the circle. `seconds` overrides `lifetime` when it is greater than zero.
- `stop() -> void` — Stops the circle and emits `finished`.
- `is_running() -> bool` — Returns `true` while the circle is running.
- `set_fill(value: float) -> void` — Sets the progressive fill, clamped to `0..1`.

### shield_bubble

<a id="shield-bubble"></a>

`ShieldBubble`

Spawn with `Sparkform.shield(target: Node2D, options: Dictionary = {}) -> ShieldBubble`.

Reactive energy bubble: a hex lattice over a dome that flashes where it is
struck, then fades when you stop it. Unlike the other modifiers this one
listens to gameplay: call `hit` with a world position.

```gdscript
var bubble := Sparkform.shield(player, {"radius": 72.0})

```

**Shape**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |

| `hex_size` | `float` | `13.0` | Hex lattice cell size. |
| `fill_alpha` | `float` | `0.12` | Opacity of the bubble fill. |
| `rim_width` | `float` | `2.5` | Rim line width. |

**Timing**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lifetime` | `float` | `0.0` | Close on its own after this many seconds; `0` holds until stopped. |
| `fade_time` | `float` | `0.2` | Seconds to fade after stop(). |
| `hit_flash` | `float` | `0.3` | How long a hit flash lasts. |

**Colors**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rim_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.55, 0.85, 1.0)` | Rim tint. |
| `fill_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.4, 0.7, 1.0)` | Fill tint. |
| `hit_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 0.98, 0.9)` | Flash tint where the bubble is struck. |

**Chaos**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.3` | Lattice jitter, breathing and hit ripple scatter. |
| `free_on_finish` | `bool` | `true` | Free the node once it has faded. |

**Methods**

- `start() -> void` — Opens the bubble. Called by `Sparkform.shield()`.
- `stop() -> void` — Fades the bubble out and frees it when `free_on_finish` is set.
- `is_running() -> bool` — `true` while the bubble is open and not already closing.
- `get_openness() -> float` — Current opening amount, `0.0` to `1.0`.
- `get_hex_count() -> int` — Number of lattice cells; exposed for tests.
- `get_hit_count() -> int` — Number of recent hits still showing; exposed for tests.
- `hit(world_point: Vector2, strength: float = 1.0) -> void` — Registers an impact at a world-space point. Safe to call every frame.
- `hex_cell_margin() -> float` — Inset left between the hex lattice and the dome rim, in pixels.
- `hit_glow_at(position: Vector2) -> float` — How strongly a hit is still glowing at a world point, `0.0` to `1.0`. Drives the per-cell flash.

| `pulse_speed` | `float` | `1.4` | Pulses travelling from the first node to the second per second. |
| `pulse_count` | `int` | `3` | Pulses travelling along the chain. |

**Timing**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fade_time` | `float` | `0.25` | Seconds to fade after stop(). |

**Colors**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `core_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 0.98, 0.92)` | Inner line tint. |

- `stop() -> void` — Fades the chain out and frees it when `free_on_finish` is set.
- `is_running() -> bool` — `true` while the chain is open and not already closing.
- `get_openness() -> float` — Current opening amount, `0.0` to `1.0`.
- `get_link_count() -> int` — Number of links drawn along the chain; exposed for tests.

### trail

<a id="trail"></a>

`TrailEffect`

Spawn with `Sparkform.trail(target: Node2D, options: Dictionary = {}) -> TrailEffect`.

Persistent ribbon that follows a node: tapering tail, per-segment fade and
optional motes. Attach it to a projectile, a dashing player or a cursor.

```gdscript
var trail := Sparkform.trail(bullet, {"history": 0.25, "width_start": 9.0})
# the trail frees itself when the target leaves the tree
```

The node lives in Sparkform's layer and records the target's global positions,
so it never inherits the target's rotation or scale.

**General**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `history` | `float` | `0.35` | Seconds of movement kept in the ribbon. |
| `width_start` | `float` | `8.0` | Ribbon width at the target, in pixels. |
| `width_end` | `float` | `0.8` | Ribbon width at the tail, in pixels. |
| `trail_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.62, 0.84, 1.0)` | Outer ribbon tint. |
| `core_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.95, 0.98, 1.0)` | Inner ribbon tint. |
| `mote_count` | `int` | `6` | Extra motes shed along the ribbon; `0` keeps it a pure ribbon. |
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.4` | Wobble in the recorded path. |
| `free_with_target` | `bool` | `true` | Free the trail when its target leaves the tree. |

**Methods**

- `attach_to(target: Node2D) -> void` — Starts following `target`. The node is expected to be parented to the Sparkform layer, so its own transform stays at the origin.
- `stop() -> void` — Drops the ribbon and frees the node.
- `get_point_count() -> int` — Number of recorded points; exposed for tests.

### vortex

<a id="vortex"></a>

`Vortex`

Spawn with `Sparkform.vortex(at: Vector2, options: Dictionary = {}) -> Vortex`.

A pull field: motes spawn on the rim, spiral inward and are recycled at the
centre, inside a faint set of spinning arcs. Charges, black holes, suction,
and a natural companion to `implosion`.

field.stop()

| `strength` | `float` | `210.0` | Inward speed at the rim, in pixels per second. |
| `spin` | `float` | `3.4` | Rotation, in radians per second. |
| `mote_count` | `int` | `26` | Motes spiralling in. |
| `mote_length` | `float` | `7.0` | Length of each mote trail. |

**Timing**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lifetime` | `float` | `0.0` | Close on its own after this many seconds; `0` holds until stopped. |
| `fade_time` | `float` | `0.3` | Seconds to fade after stop(). |

**Colors**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mote_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.6, 0.75, 1.0)` | Mote tint. |
| `core_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.85)` | Centre glow tint. |
| `field_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.32, 0.4, 0.85)` | Faint arc tint. |

**Chaos**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chaos` | `float` | `0.45` | Mote speed, spiral variance and arc wobble. |
| `use_streaks` | `bool` | `true` | Also spray a ring of C++ streaks on start when the extension is loaded. |
| `streak_count` | `int` | `140` | C++ streak particles when the field opens. |
| `free_on_finish` | `bool` | `true` | Free the node once it has faded. |

**Methods**

- `start() -> void` — Starts the field. Called by `Sparkform.vortex()`.
- `stop() -> void` — Fades the field out and frees it when `free_on_finish` is set.
- `is_running() -> bool` — `true` while the field is open and not already closing.
- `get_mote_count() -> int` — Motes currently spiralling; exposed for tests.
- `get_openness() -> float` — Current opening amount, `0.0` to `1.0`.
